chaining: free open-model inference for experiments; the per-call Magicube cost is shown next to the provider in each model's code example

free_tier.stated: Free API access to selected open-source LLM, multimodal and text-to-image models, described as a non-commercial, non-profit product. Quota and concurrency are adjusted dynamically with platform load. Calls can be redeemed with Magicubes: about 0.5 per call for lightweight models, about 1 for standard and about 2 for flagship. A per-day call count is not stated on the page read

limits.value: concurrency per model is limited dynamically by platform load, with normal single-concurrency use as the guiding principle; not for high-concurrency or SLA workloads
unverified: the daily call quota is not stated on the page read

binding_note: dynamic per-model concurrency limits and an unpublished daily quota

identity_cost.detail: the ModelScope account must first bind to an Alibaba Cloud account that has completed real-name verification before API-Inference works normally. Whether a non-mainland identity document completes that verification is unverified

reliability_note: older models are removed from API-Inference as new models are released

evidence.quote: offering them free of charge for developers to experience
evidence.proved: API-Inference is offered free of charge to developers

evidence.quote: Your ModelScope account must first bind to an Alibaba Cloud account. Additionally, to prevent abuse, the corresponding cloud account must have completed real-name verification before you can use API-Inference normally.
evidence.proved: the Alibaba Cloud account bound to ModelScope must be real-name verified

evidence.quote: Do not use it for online tasks requiring high concurrency and SLA guarantees.
evidence.proved: not suitable for high-concurrency or SLA-bound workloads

evidence.quote: As new models are released, older models may gradually be removed from API Inference.
evidence.proved: older models are removed over time
